import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.LlmGenerations.DIMCID
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.CupodTrollBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.CupodBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Dynamics
import PrisonersDilemma.BaseTheorems
import PrisonersDilemma.Base.Helpers
import PrisonersDilemma.Base.ValuationSoundness
import PrisonersDilemma.Theorems.CupodTrollBot.Helpers

open PD
open PD.Bots
open PD.BaseTheorems
namespace PD.Theorems

namespace DimcidCtbCensus

inductive SP (k : Nat) : Prog → Prog → Prop where
  | base : SP k (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k)
  | simL (p q o : Prog) :
      SP k (p.subst (.sim p q) o) (q.subst (.sim p q) o) →
      SP k (.sim p q) o
  | botSimL (p q o : Prog) :
      SP k (p.subst (.bot (.sim p q)) o) (q.subst (.bot (.sim p q)) o) →
      SP k (.bot (.sim p q)) o

theorem SP_me {k : Nat} {me oppo : Prog} (h : SP k me oppo) :
    me = DIMCID k ∨ (∃ p q, me = .sim p q) ∨ (∃ p q, me = .bot (.sim p q)) := by
  cases h with
  | base => exact Or.inl rfl
  | simL p q o _ => exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨p, q, rfl⟩)
  | botSimL p q o _ => exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨p, q, rfl⟩)

theorem subst_eq_ctb {k : Nat} {q me o : Prog}
    (hme : (∃ p₂ q₂, me = .sim p₂ q₂) ∨ (∃ p₂ q₂, me = .bot (.sim p₂ q₂)))
    (h : q.subst me o = CupodTrollBot k) : o = CupodTrollBot k ∨ o = Prog.opp := by
  cases q with
  | const a => simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | self =>
      rcases hme with ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ | ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ <;>
        simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | opp => left; simpa [Prog.subst] using h
  | bot p => simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | sim p q => simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | ite b a p q => simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | search K φg pp qq =>
      simp only [CupodTrollBot, Prog.subst, Prog.search.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨hK, hg, hp, hq⟩ := h
      cases φg with
      | plays x y a => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | impl f1 f2 => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | box n' f1 => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | neg f1 => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | diag g' f1 => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | eq p' q' =>
          simp only [Formula.subst, Formula.eq.injEq] at hg
          obtain ⟨hlhs, hrhs⟩ := hg
          cases p' with
          | const a' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | bot p'' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | sim p'' q'' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | ite b' a' p'' q'' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | search K' g' p'' q'' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | self =>
              rcases hme with ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ | ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ <;>
                simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | opp =>
              simp only [Prog.subst] at hlhs
              right; exact hlhs

theorem subst_eq_opp {q me o : Prog}
    (hme : (∃ p₂ q₂, me = .sim p₂ q₂) ∨ (∃ p₂ q₂, me = .bot (.sim p₂ q₂)))
    (h : q.subst me o = Prog.opp) : o = Prog.opp := by
  cases q with
  | const a => simp [Prog.subst] at h
  | self =>
      rcases hme with ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ | ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ <;>
        simp [Prog.subst] at h
  | opp => simpa [Prog.subst] using h
  | bot p => simp [Prog.subst] at h
  | sim p q => simp [Prog.subst] at h
  | ite b a p q => simp [Prog.subst] at h
  | search K φg pp qq => simp [Prog.subst] at h

theorem SP_opp {k : Nat} {me oppo : Prog} (h : SP k me oppo) :
    oppo = CupodTrollBot k ∨ oppo = Prog.opp := by
  induction h with
  | base => exact Or.inl rfl
  | simL p q o hprem ih =>
      rcases ih with hc | ho
      · exact subst_eq_ctb (Or.inl ⟨p, q, rfl⟩) hc
      · exact Or.inr (subst_eq_opp (Or.inl ⟨p, q, rfl⟩) ho)
  | botSimL p q o hprem ih =>
      rcases ih with hc | ho
      · exact subst_eq_ctb (Or.inr ⟨p, q, rfl⟩) hc
      · exact Or.inr (subst_eq_opp (Or.inr ⟨p, q, rfl⟩) ho)

theorem SP_not_bot (k : Nat) : ∀ oppo z, ¬ SP k oppo (.bot z) := by
  intro oppo z h
  rcases SP_opp h with hc | ho
  · simp [CupodTrollBot] at hc
  · simp at ho

theorem SP_sim_inv {k : Nat} {p q oppo : Prog}
    (h : SP k (.sim p q) oppo) :
    SP k (p.subst (.sim p q) oppo) (q.subst (.sim p q) oppo) := by
  cases h with
  | simL _ _ _ hprem => exact hprem

theorem SP_botSim_inv {k : Nat} {p q oppo : Prog}
    (h : SP k (.bot (.sim p q)) oppo) :
    SP k (p.subst (.bot (.sim p q)) oppo) (q.subst (.bot (.sim p q)) oppo) := by
  cases h with
  | botSimL _ _ _ hprem => exact hprem

/-- CTB never plays D vs DIMCID (DIMCID ≠ CupodBot, so CTB cooperates). -/
theorem ctb_not_D_vs_dimcid (k : Nat) :
    ¬ (Formula.plays (CupodTrollBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D).interp := by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  have hC : play (n + 2) (CupodTrollBot k) (DIMCID k) = some Action.C :=
    CupodTrollBot_cooperates_if_opp_not_CupodBot k n (DIMCID k) (by simp [DIMCID, CupodBot])
  have hD : play (n + 2) (CupodTrollBot k) (DIMCID k) = some Action.D :=
    eval_mono_le hn (n + 2) (by omega)
  rw [hC] at hD; simp at hD

theorem pf_WV (k : Nat) : ∀ {K : Nat} {φ : Formula},
    Pf K φ → WV (SP k) φ := by
  intro K φ h
  refine ((wv_sound_upto (SP k) (fun _ _ => False)
    (SP_not_bot k) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ K).2 K φ h).2 Pf_sound
  · intro me oppo a hT hgate
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · rcases SP_me hS with rfl | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ <;>
        rcases hgate with hb | hb <;> exact absurd hb (by simp [DIMCID])
    · exact hF.elim
  · intro me oppo hT hgate
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · rcases SP_me hS with rfl | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ <;>
        rcases hgate with hb | hb <;> exact absurd hb (by simp [DIMCID])
    · exact hF.elim
  · intro me oppo b a' p q hT hgate
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · rcases SP_me hS with rfl | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ <;>
        rcases hgate with hb | hb <;> exact absurd hb (by simp [DIMCID])
    · exact hF.elim
  · intro me oppo p hT hb
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · rcases SP_me hS with rfl | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ <;>
        exact absurd hb (by simp [DIMCID])
    · exact hF.elim
  · intro me oppo g ψ P Q hT hb
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · rcases SP_me hS with rfl | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ <;>
        exact absurd hb (by simp [DIMCID])
    · exact hF.elim
  · intro p q oppo hT
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · exact Or.inl (SP_sim_inv hS)
    · exact hF.elim
  · intro p q oppo hT
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · exact Or.inl (SP_botSim_inv hS)
    · exact hF.elim
  · -- h_search_t : the base kill
    intro oppo g ψ P Q a n hT hWV hcert
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · rcases SP_me hS with hme | ⟨p', q', hme⟩ | ⟨p', q', hme⟩
      · unfold DIMCID at hme
        injection hme with h1 h2 h3 h4
        subst h2; subst h3; subst h4
        rw [h1] at hWV hcert hS
        rcases SP_opp hS with hopp | hopp
        · subst hopp
          simp only [Formula.subst, Prog.subst] at hWV
          rw [WV_impl] at hWV
          exfalso
          have hA : WV (SP k) (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k) Action.C) := by
            rw [WV_plays]; exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, SP.base⟩
          have hcons := hWV hA
          rw [WV_plays] at hcons
          rcases hcons with ⟨hbad, _⟩ | hint
          · exact absurd hbad (by decide)
          · exact absurd hint (ctb_not_D_vs_dimcid k)
        · exfalso
          rw [hopp] at hS
          cases hS
      · simp at hme
      · simp at hme
    · exact hF.elim
  · -- h_search_f : the base else = .const C
    intro oppo g ψ P Q a n hT hcert
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · rcases SP_me hS with hme | ⟨p', q', hme⟩ | ⟨p', q', hme⟩
      · unfold DIMCID at hme
        injection hme with h1 h2 h3 h4
        subst h4
        cases hcert
        rfl
      · simp at hme
      · simp at hme
    · exact hF.elim
  · exact fun p q oppo h => SP.simL p q oppo h
  · exact fun p q oppo h => SP.botSimL p q oppo h

/-- The DIMCID guard against CupodTrollBot is unprovable at every budget. -/
theorem dimcid_ctb_guard_not_provable (k K : Nat) :
    ¬ Pf K (.impl (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k) Action.C)
                  (.plays (CupodTrollBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D)) := by
  intro h
  have hWV := pf_WV k h
  rw [WV_impl] at hWV
  have hA : WV (SP k) (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k) Action.C) := by
    rw [WV_plays]; exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, SP.base⟩
  have hcons := hWV hA
  rw [WV_plays] at hcons
  rcases hcons with ⟨hbad, _⟩ | hint
  · exact absurd hbad (by decide)
  · exact absurd hint (ctb_not_D_vs_dimcid k)

end DimcidCtbCensus

/-- DIMCID's guard search fails against CupodTrollBot. -/
theorem proofSearch_false_dimcid_vs_ctb (k : Nat) :
    proofSearch k
      ((Formula.impl (.plays .self .opp Action.C) (.plays .opp .self Action.D)).subst
        (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k)) = false := by
  cases hps : proofSearch k
      ((Formula.impl (.plays .self .opp Action.C) (.plays .opp .self Action.D)).subst
        (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k)) with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>

inductive SP (k : Nat) : Prog → Prog → Prop where
  | base : SP k (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k)
  | simL (p q o : Prog) :
      SP k (p.subst (.sim p q) o) (q.subst (.sim p q) o) →
      SP k (.sim p q) o
  | botSimL (p q o : Prog) :
      SP k (p.subst (.bot (.sim p q)) o) (q.subst (.bot (.sim p q)) o) →
      SP k (.bot (.sim p q)) o

theorem SP_me {k : Nat} {me oppo : Prog} (h : SP k me oppo) :
    me = DIMCID k ∨ (∃ p q, me = .sim p q) ∨ (∃ p q, me = .bot (.sim p q)) := by
  cases h with
  | base => exact Or.inl rfl
  | simL p q o _ => exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨p, q, rfl⟩)
  | botSimL p q o _ => exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨p, q, rfl⟩)

theorem subst_eq_ctb {k : Nat} {q me o : Prog}

    (h : q.subst me o = CupodTrollBot k) : o = CupodTrollBot k ∨ o = Prog.opp := by
  cases q with
  | const a => simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | self =>
      rcases hme with ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ | ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ <;>
        simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | opp => left; simpa [Prog.subst] using h
  | bot p => simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | sim p q => simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | ite b a p q => simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | search K φg pp qq =>
      simp only [CupodTrollBot, Prog.subst, Prog.search.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨hK, hg, hp, hq⟩ := h
      cases φg with
      | plays x y a => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | impl f1 f2 => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | box n' f1 => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | neg f1 => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | diag g' f1 => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | eq p' q' =>
          simp only [Formula.subst, Formula.eq.injEq] at hg
          obtain ⟨hlhs, hrhs⟩ := hg
          cases p' with
          | const a' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | bot p'' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | sim p'' q'' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | ite b' a' p'' q'' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | search K' g' p'' q'' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | self =>

                simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | opp =>

  cases q with

  | self =>

  | sim p q => simp [Prog.subst] at h
  | ite b a p q => simp [Prog.subst] at h

theorem SP_opp {k : Nat} {me oppo : Prog} (h : SP k me oppo) :
    oppo = CupodTrollBot k ∨ oppo = Prog.opp := by
  induction h with
  | base => exact Or.inl rfl
  | simL p q o hprem ih =>

      · exact Or.inr (subst_eq_opp (Or.inl ⟨p, q, rfl⟩) ho)
  | botSimL p q o hprem ih =>

      · exact subst_eq_ctb (Or.inr ⟨p, q, rfl⟩) hc
      · exact Or.inr (subst_eq_opp (Or.inr ⟨p, q, rfl⟩) ho)

theorem SP_not_bot (k : Nat) : ∀ oppo z, ¬ SP k oppo (.bot z) := by
  intro oppo z h
  rcases SP_opp h with hc | ho
  · simp [CupodTrollBot] at hc
  · simp at ho

import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.LlmGenerations.DIMCID
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.CupodTrollBot

inductive SP (k : Nat) : Prog → Prog → Prop where
  | base : SP k (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k)
  | simL (p q o : Prog) :
      SP k (p.subst (.sim p q) o) (q.subst (.sim p q) o) →
      SP k (.sim p q) o
  | botSimL (p q o : Prog) :
      SP k (p.subst (.bot (.sim p q)) o) (q.subst (.bot (.sim p q)) o) →
      SP k (.bot (.sim p q)) o

theorem SP_me {k : Nat} {me oppo : Prog} (h : SP k me oppo) :
    me = DIMCID k ∨ (∃ p q, me = .sim p q) ∨ (∃ p q, me = .bot (.sim p q)) := by
  cases h with
  | base => exact Or.inl rfl
  | simL p q o _ => exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨p, q, rfl⟩)
  | botSimL p q o _ => exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨p, q, rfl⟩)

theorem subst_eq_ctb {k : Nat} {q me o : Prog}
    (hme : (∃ p₂ q₂, me = .sim p₂ q₂) ∨ (∃ p₂ q₂, me = .bot (.sim p₂ q₂)))
    (h : q.subst me o = CupodTrollBot k) : o = CupodTrollBot k ∨ o = Prog.opp := by
  cases q with
  | const a => simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | self =>
      rcases hme with ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ | ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ <;>
        simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | opp => left; simpa [Prog.subst] using h
  | bot p => simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | sim p q => simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | ite b a p q => simp [Prog.subst, CupodTrollBot] at h
  | search K φg pp qq =>
      simp only [CupodTrollBot, Prog.subst, Prog.search.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨hK, hg, hp, hq⟩ := h
      cases φg with
      | plays x y a => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | impl f1 f2 => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | box n' f1 => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | neg f1 => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | diag g' f1 => simp [Formula.subst] at hg
      | eq p' q' =>
          simp only [Formula.subst, Formula.eq.injEq] at hg
          obtain ⟨hlhs, hrhs⟩ := hg
          cases p' with
          | const a' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | bot p'' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | sim p'' q'' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | ite b' a' p'' q'' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | search K' g' p'' q'' => simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | self =>
              rcases hme with ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ | ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ <;>
                simp [Prog.subst] at hlhs
          | opp =>
              simp only [Prog.subst] at hlhs
              right; exact hlhs

theorem subst_eq_opp {q me o : Prog}
    (hme : (∃ p₂ q₂, me = .sim p₂ q₂) ∨ (∃ p₂ q₂, me = .bot (.sim p₂ q₂)))
    (h : q.subst me o = Prog.opp) : o = Prog.opp := by
  cases q with
  | const a => simp [Prog.subst] at h
  | self =>
      rcases hme with ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ | ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ <;>
        simp [Prog.subst] at h
  | opp => simpa [Prog.subst] using h
  | bot p => simp [Prog.subst] at h
  | sim p q => simp [Prog.subst] at h
  | ite b a p q => simp [Prog.subst] at h
  | search K φg pp qq => simp [Prog.subst] at h

theorem SP_opp {k : Nat} {me oppo : Prog} (h : SP k me oppo) :
    oppo = CupodTrollBot k ∨ oppo = Prog.opp := by
  induction h with
  | base => exact Or.inl rfl
  | simL p q o hprem ih =>
      rcases ih with hc | ho
      · exact subst_eq_ctb (Or.inl ⟨p, q, rfl⟩) hc
      · exact Or.inr (subst_eq_opp (Or.inl ⟨p, q, rfl⟩) ho)
  | botSimL p q o hprem ih =>
      rcases ih with hc | ho
      · exact subst_eq_ctb (Or.inr ⟨p, q, rfl⟩) hc
      · exact Or.inr (subst_eq_opp (Or.inr ⟨p, q, rfl⟩) ho)

theorem SP_not_bot (k : Nat) : ∀ oppo z, ¬ SP k oppo (.bot z) := by
  intro oppo z h
  rcases SP_opp h with hc | ho
  · simp [CupodTrollBot] at hc
  · simp at ho

theorem SP_sim_inv {k : Nat} {p q oppo : Prog}
    (h : SP k (.sim p q) oppo) :
    SP k (p.subst (.sim p q) oppo) (q.subst (.sim p q) oppo) := by
  cases h with
  | simL _ _ _ hprem => exact hprem

theorem SP_botSim_inv {k : Nat} {p q oppo : Prog}
    (h : SP k (.bot (.sim p q)) oppo) :
    SP k (p.subst (.bot (.sim p q)) oppo) (q.subst (.bot (.sim p q)) oppo) := by
  cases h with
  | botSimL _ _ _ hprem => exact hprem

/-- CTB never plays D vs DIMCID (DIMCID ≠ CupodBot, so CTB cooperates). -/
theorem ctb_not_D_vs_dimcid (k : Nat) :
    ¬ (Formula.plays (CupodTrollBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D).interp := by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  have hC : play (n + 2) (CupodTrollBot k) (DIMCID k) = some Action.C :=
    CupodTrollBot_cooperates_if_opp_not_CupodBot k n (DIMCID k) (by simp [DIMCID, CupodBot])
  have hD : play (n + 2) (CupodTrollBot k) (DIMCID k) = some Action.D :=
    eval_mono_le hn (n + 2) (by omega)
  rw [hC] at hD; simp at hD

theorem pf_WV (k : Nat) : ∀ {K : Nat} {φ : Formula},
    Pf K φ → WV (SP k) φ := by
  intro K φ h
  refine ((wv_sound_upto (SP k) (fun _ _ => False)
    (SP_not_bot k) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ K).2 K φ h).2 Pf_sound
  · intro me oppo a hT hgate
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · rcases SP_me hS with rfl | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ <;>
        rcases hgate with hb | hb <;> exact absurd hb (by simp [DIMCID])
    · exact hF.elim
  · intro me oppo hT hgate
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · rcases SP_me hS with rfl | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ <;>
        rcases hgate with hb | hb <;> exact absurd hb (by simp [DIMCID])
    · exact hF.elim
  · intro me oppo b a' p q hT hgate
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · rcases SP_me hS with rfl | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ <;>
        rcases hgate with hb | hb <;> exact absurd hb (by simp [DIMCID])
    · exact hF.elim
  · intro me oppo p hT hb
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · rcases SP_me hS with rfl | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ <;>
        exact absurd hb (by simp [DIMCID])
    · exact hF.elim
  · intro me oppo g ψ P Q hT hb
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · rcases SP_me hS with rfl | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ | ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ <;>
        exact absurd hb (by simp [DIMCID])
    · exact hF.elim
  · intro p q oppo hT
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · exact Or.inl (SP_sim_inv hS)
    · exact hF.elim
  · intro p q oppo hT
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · exact Or.inl (SP_botSim_inv hS)
    · exact hF.elim
  · -- h_search_t : the base kill
    intro oppo g ψ P Q a n hT hWV hcert
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · rcases SP_me hS with hme | ⟨p', q', hme⟩ | ⟨p', q', hme⟩
      · unfold DIMCID at hme
        injection hme with h1 h2 h3 h4
        subst h2; subst h3; subst h4
        rw [h1] at hWV hcert hS
        rcases SP_opp hS with hopp | hopp
        · subst hopp
          simp only [Formula.subst, Prog.subst] at hWV
          rw [WV_impl] at hWV
          exfalso
          have hA : WV (SP k) (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k) Action.C) := by
            rw [WV_plays]; exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, SP.base⟩
          have hcons := hWV hA
          rw [WV_plays] at hcons
          rcases hcons with ⟨hbad, _⟩ | hint
          · exact absurd hbad (by decide)
          · exact absurd hint (ctb_not_D_vs_dimcid k)
        · exfalso
          rw [hopp] at hS
          cases hS
      · simp at hme
      · simp at hme
    · exact hF.elim
  · -- h_search_f : the base else = .const C
    intro oppo g ψ P Q a n hT hcert
    rcases hT with hS | hF
    · rcases SP_me hS with hme | ⟨p', q', hme⟩ | ⟨p', q', hme⟩
      · unfold DIMCID at hme
        injection hme with h1 h2 h3 h4
        subst h4
        cases hcert
        rfl
      · simp at hme
      · simp at hme
    · exact hF.elim
  · exact fun p q oppo h => SP.simL p q oppo h
  · exact fun p q oppo h => SP.botSimL p q oppo h

/-- The DIMCID guard against CupodTrollBot is unprovable at every budget. -/
theorem dimcid_ctb_guard_not_provable (k K : Nat) :
    ¬ Pf K (.impl (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k) Action.C)
                  (.plays (CupodTrollBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D)) := by
  intro h
  have hWV := pf_WV k h
  rw [WV_impl] at hWV
  have hA : WV (SP k) (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k) Action.C) := by
    rw [WV_plays]; exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, SP.base⟩
  have hcons := hWV hA
  rw [WV_plays] at hcons
  rcases hcons with ⟨hbad, _⟩ | hint
  · exact absurd hbad (by decide)
  · exact absurd hint (ctb_not_D_vs_dimcid k)

end DimcidCtbCensus

/-- DIMCID's guard search fails against CupodTrollBot. -/
theorem proofSearch_false_dimcid_vs_ctb (k : Nat) :
    proofSearch k
      ((Formula.impl (.plays .self .opp Action.C) (.plays .opp .self Action.D)).subst
        (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k)) = false := by
  cases hps : proofSearch k
      ((Formula.impl (.plays .self .opp Action.C) (.plays .opp .self Action.D)).subst
        (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k)) with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>
      have h := (proofSearch_spec k _).1 hps
      simp only [Formula.subst, Prog.subst] at h
      exact absurd h (DimcidCtbCensus.dimcid_ctb_guard_not_provable k k)

/-- DIMCID cooperates against CupodTrollBot (guard unprovable). -/
theorem DIMCID_plays_C_against_CupodTrollBot (k fuel : Nat) :
    play (fuel + 2) (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k) = some .C := by
  show (if proofSearch k
            ((Formula.impl (.plays .self .opp Action.C) (.plays .opp .self Action.D)).subst
              (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k))
          then eval (fuel + 1) (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k) (.const Action.D)
          else eval (fuel + 1) (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k) (.const Action.C)) = some .C
  rw [proofSearch_false_dimcid_vs_ctb k]; simp [eval]

theorem llm_outcome_DIMCID_vs_CupodTrollBot :
    ∃ k₂, ∀ k, k₂ < k →
      ∃ fuel, outcome fuel (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k) = some (.C, .C) := by
  refine ⟨0, fun k _ => ⟨2, ?_⟩⟩
  have hA : play 2 (DIMCID k) (CupodTrollBot k) = some .C :=
    DIMCID_plays_C_against_CupodTrollBot k 0
  have hB : play 2 (CupodTrollBot k) (DIMCID k) = some .C :=
    CupodTrollBot_cooperates_if_opp_not_CupodBot k 0 (DIMCID k) (by simp [DIMCID, CupodBot])
  exact outcome_of_plays _ _ _ _ _ hA hB

/-- CupodBot never plays D against DIMCID: its guard `.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D`
    is unprovable at every budget (circular dependency — the guard IS the atom),
    so the semantic interpretation is false. -/
theorem cupod_not_D_vs_dimcid (k : Nat) :
    ¬ (Formula.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D).interp := by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  -- We'll prove by induction on n that play n (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) ≠ some .D
  -- The key invariant: CupodBot's guard never fires because it's circular.
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp [play, eval] at hn
  | succ n ih =>
      -- play (n+1) (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) = eval (n+1) (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k)
      have hplay := hn
      unfold play at hplay
      -- eval (n+1) me opp me where me = CupodBot k, opp = DIMCID k
      simp [eval] at hplay
      -- Now hplay is a do-block result
      -- CupodBot k = .search k (.plays .opp .self .D) (.const .D) (.const .C)
      -- We need to show this evaluates to something other than some .D
      unfold CupodBot at hplay
      -- Now we have: (if proofSearch k (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D) then ... else some .C) = some .D
      -- We need to show proofSearch k (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D) = false
      -- Let's prove that by contradiction
      by_cases hps : proofSearch k (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D) = true
      · -- If proofSearch is true, then Pf k (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D) holds
        have hpf : Pf k (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D) := (proofSearch_spec k _).1 hps
        -- Now we need to derive a contradiction from this
        -- The idea: Pf k (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D) can only come from
        -- searchBranch (circular) or atom (which needs a PlaysProof)
        -- Let's use the floor lemma
        have hfloor := no_provable_searcherPlay_tail k
          (.plays .opp .self Action.D) (.const Action.D) (.const Action.C)
          (DIMCID k) Action.D
          ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ n.succ hpf (by omega)
        · exact hfloor rfl
        · -- hfalse: ¬ (g.subst (.search k g pT pE) O).interp
          -- g = .plays .opp .self .D
          -- g.subst (.search k g pT pE) O = .plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D
          -- This is exactly what we're trying to prove false, so we can't use this lemma directly.
          -- We need a different approach.
          sorry
        · -- hshape: branches not both const
          intro c0 c1 h; injection h; simp
        · -- hinner: then-branch not inner search for aTgt
          intro k₂ ψ₂ c1 h
          have : CupodBot k ≠ .search k₂ ψ₂ (.const Action.D) (.const c1) := by
            intro heq
            unfold CupodBot at heq
            injection heq with h1 h2 h3
            -- h1: k = k₂, h2: .plays .opp .self .D = ψ₂, h3: .const .D = .const c1
            -- From h3: Action.D = c1
            -- So this would mean CupodBot's then-branch is an inner search for .D
            -- But CupodBot's then-branch is .const .D, not an inner search
            injection h3
          exact this h
        · -- hplug: not a searchPlug continuation
          intro L h
          unfold CupodBot at h
          injection h with h1 h2
          -- h1: k = some head, h2: the rest
          -- But searchPlug L (.const .D) would require the head to be a search layer
          -- and the tail to match. This is complex.
          sorry
        · -- hctxT: not a ctxPlug continuation
          intro L h
          sorry
        · -- hplug2: not a plug2 continuation
          intro hd L h
          sorry
      · -- proofSearch is false, so the else branch is taken: some .C
        rw [hps] at hplay
        simp at hplay
        -- hplay: some .C = some .D
        injection hplay

theorem llm_outcome_DIMCID_vs_CupodBot :
    ∃ k₂, ∀ k, k₂ < k →
      ∃ fuel, outcome fuel (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) = some (.C, .C) := by
  refine ⟨0, fun k _ => ⟨2, ?_⟩⟩
  have hA : play 2 (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) = some .C := by
    -- DIMCID's guard: .impl (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .C) (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D)
    -- We need to show proofSearch k of this guard is false
    -- This requires showing the consequent is unprovable
    sorry
  have hB : play 2 (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) = some .C := by
    have hg : proofSearch k (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D) = false := by
      cases hps : proofSearch k (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D) with
      | true => 
          -- This would imply Pf k of the atom, which is impossible (circular)
          have hpf : Pf k (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D) := (proofSearch_spec k _).1 hps
          -- Use the floor lemma or a direct argument
          sorry
      | false => rfl
    unfold CupodBot
    simp [eval, Prog.subst, Formula.subst, hg]
  exact outcome_of_plays _ _ _ _ _ hA hB

end PD.Theorems"}

        simp only [Nat.add_assoc])

/-- DIMCID never plays D against CupodBot, and CupodBot never plays D against DIMCID.
    Proved by simultaneous induction on fuel. The key: if either bot's guard were
    provable, soundness would force the other bot to actually play D, contradicting
    the induction hypothesis. -/
theorem dimcid_cupod_mutual_not_D (k fuel : Nat) :
    play fuel (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) ≠ some Action.D ∧
    play fuel (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) ≠ some Action.D := by
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
      simp [play, eval]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨ihD, ihC⟩
      -- First, handle CupodBot's play (simpler)
      have h_cupod : play (fuel + 1) (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) ≠ some Action.D := by
        unfold play
        -- CupodBot k = .search k (.plays .opp .self .D) (.const .D) (.const .C)
        have h_eval : eval (fuel + 1) (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) =
            (if proofSearch k (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D) then
              some Action.D
            else
              some Action.C) := by
          unfold CupodBot
          simp [eval, Prog.subst, Formula.subst]
        rw [h_eval]
        by_cases hps : proofSearch k (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D) = true
        · rw [hps]; simp; exact ihD
        · rw [hps]; simp
      -- Second, handle DIMCID's play

        -- DIMCID k = .search k (.impl (.plays .self .opp .C) (.plays .opp .self .D)) (.const .D) (.const .C)

                (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k))

          unfold DIMCID

          (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k))

          -- Alternative: use weakenImpl? No.

                -- Its size is |.box k ψ| + |.plays ...| + 1
                -- |.box k ψ| = numCost k + |ψ| = log2 k + 1 + |ψ|
                -- |.plays ...| = |DIMCID k| + |CupodBot k| + 1
                -- This might be > k for small k. Let's check.

                -- Let's compute:

                omega)

    -- Wait, h_eval says play = some .D, but h says play ≠ some .D
    -- Actually h is: play fuel (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) ≠ some .D, not (fuel+2)
    sorry
  · rw [hps]; rfl

/-- CupodBot plays C against DIMCID (for any fuel ≥ 2) because its guard is unprovable. -/
theorem cupod_plays_C_vs_dimcid (k fuel : Nat) :
    play (fuel + 2) (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) = some Action.C := by
  unfold play
  have h_eval : eval (fuel + 2) (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) =
      (if proofSearch k (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D) then
        some Action.D
      else
        some Action.C) := by
    unfold CupodBot
    simp [eval, Prog.subst, Formula.subst]
  rw [h_eval]
  by_cases hps : proofSearch k (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D) = true
  · -- guard true → plays D, but this contradicts the mutual not-D lemma
    have h := (dimcid_cupod_mutual_not_D k (fuel + 2)).2
    rw [hps] at h_eval
    simp at h_eval
    -- h_eval: some .D = some .D, which is trivially true
    -- But h says play (fuel+2) (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) ≠ some .D
    -- And h_eval says it equals some .D
    rw [h_eval] at h
    exact absurd rfl h
  · rw [hps]; rfl

/-- **DIMCID vs CupodBot: mutual cooperation (C, C)** for all k.
    Both bots' guards are circular (they refer to the plays they're trying to determine),
    so neither guard can be proved within the proof system S. Both fall through to their
    cooperate else-branches, yielding (C, C). -/
theorem llm_outcome_DIMCID_vs_CupodBot :
    ∃ k₂, ∀ k, k₂ < k →
      ∃ fuel, outcome fuel (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) = some (.C, .C) := by
  refine ⟨0, fun k _ => ⟨2, ?_⟩⟩
  have hA : play 2 (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) = some .C :=
    dimcid_plays_C_vs_cupod k 0
  have hB : play 2 (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) = some .C :=
    cupod_plays_C_vs_dimcid k 0
  exact outcome_of_plays _ _ _ _ _ hA hB

end PD.Theorems"}

{"notebook": "## 2026-07-31 DIMCID vs CupodBot investigation

### Key insight from the DIMCID vs CupodTrollBot proof (already in library):
The DIMCID guard `A → B` where:
- A = .plays (DIMCID k) (Opponent k) .C  ("I play C vs opponent")
- B = .plays (Opponent k) (DIMCID k) .D  ("Opponent plays D vs me")

### For CupodBot vs DIMCID:
- CupodBot guard: .plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D  ("opponent plays D vs me")
- DIMCID guard: .plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .C → .plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D

### For CupodBot vs CupodTrollBot (already solved):
- CupodTrollBot guard: .eq (CupodBot j) (CupodBot j)  -- structural identity
- DIMCID guard: .plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot j) .C → .plays (CupodBot j) (DIMCID k) .D
- Proof uses WV valuation with SP (search-closed) relation
- Key lemma: ctb_not_D_vs_dimcid (CupodTrollBot never plays D vs DIMCID)

### Current approach for DIMCID vs CupodBot:
Both guards are circular:
1. CupodBot's play of D depends on whether its guard .plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D is provable
2. DIMCID's play of D depends on whether its guard .plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .C → .plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D is provable

Both are unprovable due to circularity (the atom B appears in the guard that determines whether B is provable).

### Solution strategy:
Use the floor lemma `no_provable_searcherPlay_tail` for CupodBot vs DIMCID (similar to PrudentBot vs PrudentBot).
The key: CupodBot's guard is its OWN play atom, so it's a "searcher play" floor case.

For DIMCID vs CupodBot, the guard is an implication. If the implication is provable, then since DIMCID plays C (when guard is unprovable), we'd need to prove the antecedent to get the consequent... but that's circular.

Actually, simpler: both bots' plays are determined by proofSearch of atoms that are unprovable due to circularity. We can prove:
1. proofSearch k (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D) = false for all k
2. proofSearch k (dimcid_guard k) = false for all k

Then both play C.

### The simp problem:
The `simp [eval, Prog.subst, Formula.subst]` doesn't reduce the eval of .search fully because the proofSearch argument is a complex formula. Need to compute the eval manually or use a different approach.

### Key files:
- Theorems/DIMCID/vs_CupodTrollBot.lean - solved with WV valuation
- Theorems/PrudentBot/vs_PrudentBot.lean - solved with floor lemma
- Base/Exclusion.lean - has no_provable_searcherPlay_tail

### Plan:
1. Prove `cupod_not_D_vs_dimcid` using `no_provable_searcherPlay_tail`
2. Prove `dimcid_guard_not_provable` using circularity (searchBranch + boxIntro → Pf of plays atom → contradiction)
3. Use these to show both play C
"}
